'''Casey Barson'''<ref name="dt-19913">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19913 My Way's Not Very Sportsmanlike], DeckTech (Casey "Smeg" Barson, 5 December 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19913/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19913/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Smeg''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in December 2001.
